bear_assumptions: USD 11.00 normalized EPS at 8x as wholesale weakness, HEYDUDE contraction, markdowns, margin pressure and leverage reduce earnings and compress the multiple.
base_assumptions: USD 13.85 adjusted EPS guidance midpoint at 10.5x as direct-to-consumer and international growth offset wholesale and HEYDUDE weakness while margins remain below prior peaks and net debt declines gradually.
bull_assumptions: USD 14.70 normalized EPS at 14x as broad Crocs Brand growth, HEYDUDE stabilization, margin recovery, debt reduction and accretive repurchases improve per-share economics.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh evidence preserves the operating thesis while both downside-payoff ratios and the accepted-relationship gate clear; downgrade on sustained core-brand contraction, continued HEYDUDE deterioration, structural margin erosion, weak cash conversion, rising markdowns or inventories, refinancing pressure, or capital returns that weaken per-share value.
